system.description: Chanting the Sixfold Devotion to the Maker's Resolution, the weaver's own pattern etches itself onto his forehead over the course of five ticks, then flashes brilliantly and fades from sight. Thereafter, for the remainder of the scene, he is immune to all forms of mental influence, be they natural or unnatural, save those that come from the Divine Ministers or Autochthon himself, should he ever awaken. Additionally, Alchemical weavers cannot be infected with Gremlin Syndrome while this protocol is active.
